sources: https://rushford.govoffice.com/vertical/sites/%7BB41348D8-65FE-49A4-B879-4733A535B479%7D/uploads/Northend_campground_map_and_rules_2024.pdf (Northend Campground map and policy, 2024; scanned, read as images)

hookups.source: City of Rushford Northend Campground page ('Seven sites are complete with electric, sewer and water hookups') + 2024 campground map ('7 RV Sites ... Site 1-3 30 amps Sites 4-7 50 amps') and policy ('Electrical, water and sewer hookups at site 1-7'), read 2026-11-11

sites.source: City of Rushford 2024 Northend Campground map: RV sites 1-7 ('Limit - 1 RV - 2 Vehicles Per Site') and tent sites 8-10, read 2026-11-11

facilities.source: City of Rushford Northend Campground page ('a shelter and restroom complete with showers') + 2024 policy ('Waste water dump station at site'; '$5.00 for use of waste water dump facility'), read 2026-11-11

season.source: City of Rushford Northend Campground page ('The campground is open from mid April through Oct 31st'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: Reserve and register at Pam's Corner Convenience Store (507-864-7949); fees paid in advance; checkout 2 p.m.

booking.source: City of Rushford Northend Campground page ('Campers interested in reserving a spot should call Pam's Corner Convenience Store at 507-864-7949 to make reservations') + 2024 policy ('Campers are required to register at Pam's Corner'; 'Checkout time is 2:00 p.m.'), read 2026-11-11

values.note: $35 a night for a site with electric, water and sewer; tent site $20. Plus 7.375% state and county sales tax and 3% city lodging tax. City of Rushford campground policy, 2024.

fees.source: https://rushford.govoffice.com/vertical/sites/%7BB41348D8-65FE-49A4-B879-4733A535B479%7D/uploads/Northend_campground_map_and_rules_2024.pdf ('Fees: $35.00 for site with electric, water, sewer; $20.00 for tent site'; '7.375% State & County sales tax ... and 3.0% City lodging tax'), read 2026-11-11

note: City of Rushford campground at the north end of town, across Hwy 43 from Creekside Park, near Rush Creek and the Root River State Trail; the RV sites sit in one row beside the restroom, with three tent sites up the drive. --Claude
summary: City page + 2024 map/policy PDF read: 7 RV sites with electric (sites 1-3 30A, 4-7 50A), water and sewer + 3 tent sites, showers, dump ($5), open mid-April to Oct 31, reserve by phone at Pam's Corner; $35 RV / $20 tent plus 10.375% tax. Old note's '8 RV sites' and '$25 RV' corrected.
flags: Old note said 8 RV sites and $25 RV; the city's page and 2024 policy say 7 full-hookup sites at $35.
Phone 507-864-7949 is Pam's Corner, the reservation/registration line named by the city: keep. City Hall is 507-864-2444.
Pin 43.81560,-91.75400 sits on the RV row (campers visible on imagery): OK. Not waterfront confirmed: Rush Creek runs in a levee channel ~70-90 m south, behind a levee and trail.
